screenshotCaptures.captureModeInterpretationNote: QA_PROTOCOL.md says 'capture mode: viewport screenshot' and gives a fixed reference PNG physical size (935x1683 / 724x2172). Every master PNG, however, visibly contains a full page's worth of sections (header through footer) compressed into that same fixed canvas — the same 'design-export canvas size, not a literal 1:1 browser viewport' pattern already seen in the GD6 Revision 3 masters (documented in that phase's certification). A literal fixed-viewport crop of a real, much taller implemented page would only ever compare the very top of the page against the master's entire compressed composition. This tool therefore captures fullPage (real scrollable height) at the specified WIDTH and deviceScaleFactor, so the whole implemented page is comparable section-by-section against the whole master image — an interpretation call, not a silent default, flagged here for ChatGPT's review rather than resolved unilaterally.
screenshotCaptures.rawDiffPercentMethodologyNote: Per PHA2_PRE_HANDOFF_CORRECTION (explicit user instruction): the raw diff percentages above (44.81%-74.59%) are recorded as-is and are NOT characterized here as unimportant, expected, or a self-assessed PASS. The captureModeInterpretationNote above documents a factual mechanism (the diff tool compares only the first min(masterHeight, capturedHeight) rows against a master canvas that is itself shorter than the real implemented page) that contributes to why the raw percentage is high — that is a methodology fact, not a fidelity judgment. Whether the underlying implementation is visually acceptable is a determination reserved entirely for ChatGPT's PHA3 QA; this receipt does not draw that conclusion.

findings.defect:
PropertyListRow2's price+'Xem chi tiết' button row used justify-content:space-between without constraining the price

's width, so at 935px width the button overflowed its own row by up to ~8px (visible as the row/page rendering 943px wide instead of 935px in the first capture pass).

Changed the row to a normal flex row where the price

is 'min-w-0 flex-1' (shrinks/wraps first) and the button stays 'shrink-0', instead of relying on space-between to keep both children inside the container.

knownDeviations.item: Price/area filters are single bucketed <select> dropdowns (existing PRICE_RANGES/AREA_RANGES from lib/rentalFilters.ts), not the master's dual Từ/Đến inputs + range slider.
knownDeviations.reason: The existing RentalFilterState/filterProperties model only supports bucketed ranges, not arbitrary from/to values — building real continuous-range filtering would be a new backend/filtering capability beyond 'implement responsive behavior required by the contract' / 'wire existing UX and backend without visual drift'. Rendering a slider that doesn't actually filter would be worse (a fake control). This deviation from the approved master is NOT authorized by Claude and is NOT self-certified — it is flagged pending explicit ChatGPT PHA3 review/decision (accept, or require real backend range-filtering work as a follow-up task). The authority documents (IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.json etc.) were not altered to retroactively justify this.
